import yaml, sys

for path in [".claude/agents/security-auditor.md", ".claude/agents/system-operator.md"]:

        content = f.read()
    parts = content.split("---")
    if len(parts) < 3:
        sys.exit(f"Invalid frontmatter in {path}")
    data = yaml.safe_load(parts[1])
    print(f"Validated {path}: {data}")
